concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-transaction-lifecycle]] - provider-level transaction-status route distinguishing authorization holds, settlement submission, processor settling, settled merchant-account movement, and separate bank-account funding timing
warnings: Do not describe an authorization hold as removal of customer funds.
Do not equate Submitted for Settlement or Settling with Settled status or completed bank funding.
The page says Settled funds are routed to the merchant's bank account but does not document bank-arrival timing.
Treat the 2026-09-16 raw as collected evidence rather than proof of current status timing or support.
